subtitle: A lighting and fog test battle.
briefing: Explore the mirrored battlefield at night. Fog clears permanently within two hexes of your troops. Player-held villages light up; losing a village extinguishes its lamp. Every death leaves a persistent red light. Defeat the opposing commander while keeping yours alive. Use Settings → Debug tools to start a performance trace.
debrief: The opposing commander has fallen. You can download the trace from Settings → Debug tools or start Mirror Night again.
